integrity: Mathematical proofs, claims and code are original to this presentation; background sources are attributed. Self-review only; not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Applies to conference graphs, equality and the odd-edge-parity ternary relation; no counting or richer signatures. title: Three four-variable theories of conference-graph switching two-graphs with sharp deletion tolerance
